input: Find a local woodturning club to observe

gold.taskTitle: Find a Local Woodturning Club to Observe
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify a nearby woodturning club that the user can visit and observe in person.

questions.title: What city or region are you located in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to narrow the search to genuinely local clubs.

questions.title: How far are you willing to travel to attend?
questions.description: Establish a maximum travel distance or commute time the user is comfortable with.

questions.title: Do you have any woodturning experience at all?
questions.description: Determine whether the user is a complete beginner or has some background, as this may affect which club is the best fit.

questions.title: Are you open to joining, or strictly observing first?
questions.description: Clarify whether the goal is purely a one-time visit to watch, or whether joining is a longer-term intention.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred day or time to visit?
questions.description: Understand scheduling constraints so only clubs with compatible meeting times are considered.

questions.title: Is there a specific woodturning style or focus you want to see?
questions.description: Find out if the user is interested in a particular style such as bowls, spindle work, or artistic pieces, to match them with the right club.

questions.title: How soon do you want to attend your first visit?
questions.description: Establish a target timeline so the search and outreach can be prioritised accordingly.
